name: Bismuth Android
description: Android ARM64 settings UI and experimental rendering research for Geometry Dash 2.2081.

diagnostics.name: Diagnostic logging
diagnostics.description: Write Bismuth safe-mode initialization information to the Geode log.

hud-enabled.name: Live performance HUD
hud-enabled.description: Show a compact top-left in-game HUD. Values are limited to metrics actually measured by this package.

hud-advanced.name: Advanced monitor
hud-advanced.description: Show frame interval percentiles, estimated 1% low, CPU update time, hitch count, and sample count.

hud-graph.name: Frame cadence graph
hud-graph.description: Show a compact rolling 24-sample frame-cadence graph in Advanced Monitor.

hud-memory.name: Process memory (RSS)
hud-memory.description: Show resident process memory from /proc/self/statm. This is total process RSS, not native-heap-only memory.
